### K4FH

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, out.width="25%", out.height="25%", warning=F, results='show', fig.show='show',message=FALSE}
gene_mpra_3rMean <- (read.table("mean_k4fh_external_norm_RPK.txt",header=T)[,1:8])
row.names(gene_mpra_3rMean) <- gene_id_list
r2_hsp_matrix <-( gene_mpra_2r_3line[,33:40])
r1_hsp_matrix <- (gene_mpra_2r_3line[,41:48])

top_200_nonmonotonic <- gene_id_list[order(rank((gene_mpra_3rMean$r3_S1+1)/(gene_mpra_3rMean$r3_S1d5+1))+rank(-gene_mpra_3rMean$r3_S1))[1:300]]
ctrl_200_monotonic <- gene_id_list[order(rank((gene_mpra_3rMean$r3_S5+1)/(gene_mpra_3rMean$r3_S1+1))+rank(-gene_mpra_3rMean$r3_S1))[1:300]]
#write.table(top_200_nonmonotonic,"~/mnt/scratch/pol2_cuttag/CutAndRun/alignment/endo_gene_list/top_200_nonmonotonic.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = F)
#write.table(ctrl_200_monotonic,"~/mnt/scratch/pol2_cuttag/CutAndRun/alignment/endo_gene_list/ctrl_200_monotonic.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = F)


fc_df <- data.frame(fc=(gene_mpra_3rMean[,1]+1)/(gene_mpra_3rMean[,8]+1), row.names = row.names(gene_mpra_3rMean))

for (i in training_list) { # smallError_list
#for (i in c("chr14_94862400_94862600_posS")) { # smallError_list
conc_tf=conc_foxa1*conc_hnf4a
lib_3rMean=gene_mpra_3rMean
sf  <- splinefun(log(conc_tf), lib_3rMean[i,], method = "natural")  # or loess then predict
xx  <- seq(min(log(conc_tf), na.rm=TRUE), max(log(conc_tf), na.rm=TRUE), length.out = 2000)
dydx <- abs(sf(xx, deriv = 1))
x_star <- exp(xx[which.max(dydx)])
Kd_start_=x_star
n_start=2
#lower_Kd=1/(9*kd_score_F_table[i,]$kas*kd_score_H_table[i,]$kas)
lower_Kd=min(conc_tf)
upper_Kd= max(conc_tf)  # max(1/kd_score_F_table[i,]$kas/kd_score_H_table[i,]$kas,conc_tf)  # max(conc_tf)
range_x <- exp(c(seq(-4,10,0.2)))

  tmp_output <- fit_2r_function_order_loop_coefstd(conc_tf,lib_3rMean,r1_hsp_matrix,r2_hsp_matrix,Kd_start_,n_start,lower_Kd,upper_Kd,range_x,seq_name=i,printName=T)
  correlations[i,] <- tmp_output$r2[1]

  curr_trained_4par_df[i,]$Kd <- tmp_output$coef$Kd
  curr_trained_4par_df[i,]$n <- tmp_output$coef$n
  curr_trained_4par_df[i,]$Fmax <- tmp_output$coef$Fmax
  curr_trained_4par_df[i,]$basal <- tmp_output$coef$basal
  curr_trained_4par_df[i,]$regP <- tmp_output$coef$regP
  curr_trained_4par_df[i,]$r2 <- tmp_output$r2[1]

  curr_trained_4std_df[i,]$Kd <- tmp_output$std$Kd
  curr_trained_4std_df[i,]$n <- tmp_output$std$n
  curr_trained_4std_df[i,]$Fmax <- tmp_output$std$Fmax
  curr_trained_4std_df[i,]$basal <- tmp_output$std$basal
  curr_trained_4std_df[i,]$regP <- tmp_output$std$regP

  curr_trained_4p_df[i,]$Kd <- tmp_output$pvalue$Kd
  curr_trained_4p_df[i,]$n <- tmp_output$pvalue$n
  curr_trained_4p_df[i,]$Fmax <- tmp_output$pvalue$Fmax
  curr_trained_4p_df[i,]$basal <- tmp_output$pvalue$basal

    r1_trained_4std_df[i,]$Kd <- tmp_output$coef1$Kd
  r1_trained_4std_df[i,]$n <- tmp_output$coef1$n
  r1_trained_4std_df[i,]$Fmax <- tmp_output$coef1$Fmax
  r1_trained_4std_df[i,]$basal <- tmp_output$coef1$basal

  r2_trained_4std_df[i,]$Kd <- tmp_output$coef2$Kd
  r2_trained_4std_df[i,]$n <- tmp_output$coef2$n
  r2_trained_4std_df[i,]$Fmax <- tmp_output$coef2$Fmax
  r2_trained_4std_df[i,]$basal <- tmp_output$coef2$basal


  curr_trained_biostd_df[i,]$Kd <- tmp_output$biostd$Kd
  curr_trained_biostd_df[i,]$n <- tmp_output$biostd$n
  curr_trained_biostd_df[i,]$Fmax <- tmp_output$biostd$Fmax
  curr_trained_biostd_df[i,]$basal <- tmp_output$biostd$basal
  curr_trained_biostd_df[i,]$regP <- tmp_output$biostd$regP

}

plot(fc_df[training_list,],curr_trained_4par_df[training_list,]$Fmax/curr_trained_4par_df$basal,log="xy")
draw_diag()
#new_pars <- fit_all(curr_trained_4par_df,order1_list,order2_list,order3_list)
#changing_Fmax1 <- new_pars$Fmax
hist(correlations$m1,breaks=20)


write.table(curr_trained_4par_df,"~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/hessian_se/gHill_gene_k4fh_trained_par.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
write.table(curr_trained_4std_df,"~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/hessian_se/gHill_gene_k4fh_trained_coefstd.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
write.table(curr_trained_4p_df,"~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/hessian_se/gHill_gene_k4fh_trained_pvalues.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = T)

write.table(r1_trained_4std_df,"~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/hessian_se/gHill_gene_k4fh_trained_par_r1.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
write.table(r2_trained_4std_df,"~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/hessian_se/gHill_gene_k4fh_trained_par_r2.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = T)

write.table(curr_trained_biostd_df,"~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/hessian_se/gHill_gene_k4fh_trained_biostd.txt",sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F,col.names = T)
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, out.width="25%", out.height="25%", warning=F, results='show', fig.show='show',message=FALSE}
  curr_trained_biostd_df[i,]$regP <- tmp_output$biostd$regP


}
```
